layout.hierarchy: The schematic dominates absolutely; there is no title. Largest text: vertical 'Encoder' (red) and 'Decoder' (green) bold-italic panel labels (~36-40pt). Next: the tri-color 'Encoder / Decoder / Attention' caption (~16-18pt) and 'Encoder Block M' bar labels (~12-16pt). Then bar captions (~9-11pt bold). Smallest: X/Y subscripts, Word labels, and tiny white text inside the blue attention boxes (~6-7pt). The thick red and green container borders are the strongest structural cues; color (red/green/blue/purple) carries more weight than text size.

visual_elements.description: ENCODER PANEL: red-bordered container with vertical red bold-italic 'Encoder' on its left edge. Top row: eight small yellow rectangles with red borders labeled Y_0, Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4, Y_5, then a blue six-dot ellipsis, then Y_{N-1}, Y_N. Below, a light-purple backdrop holds four dark-purple bars with white bold text, top to bottom: 'Encoder Block M', 'Encoder Block 2', 'Encoder Block 1', 'Encoder Block 0'; each gap between bars (and above the top bar) contains ~6 vertical columns of small navy dots with a red upward arrow per column; a row of red up-arrows also runs between the stack top and the Y row. Below the stack: row of yellow boxes X_0...X_5, blue ellipsis, X_{N-1}, X_N; then a tan full-width bar 'Word Embedding' (red text); then a pale-blue bar 'Positional Encoding / Embedding' (blue text); then bottom row of yellow boxes labeled Word 0, Word 1, Word 2, Word 3, Word 4, Word 5, a gray dotted ellipsis, Word N-2, Word N-1, with ~8 small blue up-arrows from the word boxes to the pale-blue bar. Implied flow bottom-to-top: words -> positional/word embedding -> X tokens -> Encoder Blocks 0...M -> Y tokens.
visual_elements.position: left panel, ~4%-48% of slide width, ~7%-96% of height

visual_elements.description: CENTRAL COLUMN + ARROWS: tall narrow column (~1.5% slide width) filled with dense horizontal blue stripes on white, representing the stack of encoder output vectors; thin blue connector lines run from its top and fan left down to each Y box. On its right edge, horizontal arrows feed the decoder: a thick red right-arrow at ~30% height tagged with a yellow circle 'K'; a bundle of ~4 hatched blue-and-white striped right-arrows just below; a thick red right-arrow at ~50% height tagged with a yellow circle 'V'; and two solid dark-blue right-arrows at ~57% and ~73% heights aligned with the decoder's lower attention rows. A thin diagonal blue line crosses at the column's bottom tip. Below the column sits the tri-color caption stacked on three lines: 'Encoder' (red bold italic), 'Decoder' (green bold italic), 'Attention' (blue bold italic).
visual_elements.position: center strip, ~48%-57% width, ~10%-90% height (caption at bottom)

visual_elements.description: DECODER PANEL: green-bordered container with vertical green bold-italic 'Decoder' on its right edge. Top to bottom: (1) tiny red label 'Tokens' (with small red brace) over a row of ~10 white circles with red outlines; (2) row of ~10 magenta circles; (3) row of ~10 green circles, with thin connecting lines among all three rows in a fully-connected pattern (every circle linked to every circle in the adjacent rows); (4) red bar, white bold text 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization'; (5) green bar, yellow bold text 'Feed Forward Networks - One Hidden with RELU Activation'; (6) row of six blue boxes, white text 'Encoder Decoder Attention' (each with a tiny sub-label [?]), with small yellow 'K' and 'V' tags where the encoder arrows enter; (7) red bar 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization'; (8) second row of six blue 'Encoder Decoder Attention' boxes; (9) row of six small gray squares; (10) red bar 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization'; (11) green bar 'Feed Forward Networks - One Hidden with RELU Activation'; (12) third row of six blue 'Encoder Decoder Attention' boxes; (13) red bar 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization'; (14) row of six blue boxes 'Masked Multi-Headed Attention'; (15) purple bar, white bold text 'Word and Position Embedding', with tiny blue end-labels 'POS' (left) and 'm/t/de' [?] (right); (16) bottom row of small yellow token boxes. A yellow circle 'Q' with a thick red up-arrow enters the Masked Multi-Headed Attention row from the bottom right.
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with red border containing red bold text '57'.
Thin solid black horizontal strip spanning the full slide width at the very bottom edge (video-player progress bar captured in the screenshot; not slide content).
